text_block_list.text: Since Mejiro Bright wasn't feeling well, I decided to have her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Much obliged, Trainer.
I shall take a brief rest, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Is this... the Mejiro estate?

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeight, nine, ten!
Alright, time to go find Bright~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! That's right, I'm in the middle
of playing hide-and-seek with Sister Ryan right now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, where should I hide today?
Quietly, quietly, so no one finds me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, dear sister would never suspect
that I am hiding inside the warehouse♪

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright~?
Where did you go~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yees, I am over here...♪
Please hurry and find me~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, maybe I should give Onee-sama a big 'Boo!' when she opens this door...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Dear Sister~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Dear Sister?
Are you still hesitating~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Onee-sama, I am right here~.
So just like always..."

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Bright!
Found you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...! Dear sister!!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Bright?! ...Ah!
Hehe, did the dark get a little scary?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No. Even in the dark,
I am not afraid. Because――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“—Because no matter when, Onee-sama
always found me.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. What nostalgic memories.
Now then, I need to do my best in training this week too~.

Perhaps thanks to the break,
Mejiro Bright regained her energy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Dear Sister~?
Are you still having trouble deciding~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hide-and-seek won't be over until you
find me, you know~. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...I feel so lonely~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“......*Gasp*.
Was that... a dream......?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Indeed, if she is the real deal, surely my elder sister will find me...
Mejiro Bright seems to have had bad dreams and couldn't get enough proper rest.
